title: Belgian Electoral Candidate Lists
descriptions: The database consists of all Belgian candidate lists presented by the major parties between 1995 and 2019. This data has been complemented (when available) with data about the characteristics of candidates (gender, ethnicity, occupation, and residence). See the document "data collection and availability" for more information.
